choices.why: No mustard option exists, so I chose the only velvet sofa; its rich texture and wooden legs give a calm base for the colorful cushions and throw.
The natural rattan tub chair is the classic bohemian piece and its honey tone matches the parquet.
The kilim pattern is boho, and at 170x240 cm it is large enough to sit under both the sofa and the armchair.
The colorful folk print with red tassels brings the joy and bohemian color the user asked for, with two on the sofa and one on the armchair.
The leafy, easy-care ZZ plants make the room feel lived-in, with one large plant by the balcony door and others on the bookcase and in the corners.
It is the only low bookcase, and it is narrow enough to fit under the window; its warm wood matches the floor.
The low round walnut table is warm and relaxed, and it pairs well with the rattan and the sofa legs.
The rice paper lamp gives soft light and an organic, bohemian look.
The fringed plaid adds a cozy pattern that softens the dark velvet without competing with the cushions.

answer.why: Rattan, warm wood, paper and green plants set an organic bohemian base that matches the parquet, and the folk prints, kilim and throw add the pattern and color that make the room feel lived-in and cheerful.
